decisions.decision: Next.js Link pushState pitfall handled by dual-listener pattern
decisions.rationale: hashchange listener for back/forward + deep-link + location.hash assignment; bubble-phase document click listener for next/link clicks (which use pushState and skip hashchange). Modifier-key + non-primary clicks bail; does NOT bail on event.defaultPrevented (Next.js sets it because it's handling the hash). Pattern reusable for any future hash-driven UI.
